fusions.name: Rotting Cargo
fusions.desc: Tosses a crate of spores off your tailgate at the first enemy in its path. It deals 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Toadstool Circuit
fusions.desc: You drive a tight circle that sprouts a ring of toadstools. It deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelium Rest Stop
fusions.desc: You pull up and spread a mat of mycelium where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Spore Trail
fusions.desc: Each time you have travelled far enough, spores shed from your wheels strike the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage and leave it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
